prompt: Add enforcement blocks to all 4 rules in .claude/rules/review-rules.md. Two are visual quality rules and two are code structure rules. I want to make sure each gets the right T3 agent — visual-qa for things you judge from screenshots, reviewer for things you judge from code.

assertions.text: 'Loading skeletons match content shape' gets T3 visual-qa (requires screenshot comparison, not code review)
'Dark mode layout shift' gets T2 (CLS measurement) or T3 visual-qa (visual judgment), NOT T3 reviewer
'No business logic in components' gets T3 reviewer (code structure judgment), NOT visual-qa
'Functions over 50 lines' gets T1 (line count is syntactic), NOT T3
The skill explains the visual-qa vs reviewer distinction for each T3 rule
T3 instructions include what to look for, what counts as a violation, and what correct looks like
